description: Calculate a Chinese BaZi chart: the year, month, day and hour pillars (heavenly stems and earthly branches with Chinese characters and pinyin), the Day Master, the five elements count, the year animal, with approved plain meanings and a link to the free BaZi page. Use when someone asks "my BaZi", "four pillars of destiny", "my Day Master", "what element am I" or "my Chinese zodiac element". Month and year change at exact solar terms (Li Chun, not January 1), found with an ephemeris. birth_time is optional: without it the chart has three pillars and the result says so.

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.

name: get_bazi_chart
title: BaZi four pillars
